episodes.instruction: Pick the cylindrical mug with Starbucks logo from the table, rotate it, place it in the middle, and hang it onto the dark gray rack with flat back.
Grab the beige coffee mug from the table, rotate it, and set it in the center. Then hang the beige coffee mug on the dark gray rack with flat back.
Grab the mug shaped like a cylinder, turn it, set it on the table, then hang it on the rack with straight and slanted rods.
